text:
zoe: kicking off change-window deploy for inference-edge v6.2. Quiet window 23:00-02:00 UTC. Goal: enable llm_fastpath_toggle with tiny canary then staged tilt. Plan: 0 -> 0.04 (canary 7 hosts) -> 0.28 -> 0.7 -> 1.0 over ~40m. enterprise+regulated cohorts pinned to model=v2.0 until final approval. release notes: https://internal.redwood/releases/2026-03-27/edge-v6.2

matt: ack. please add deploybot holdpoint after the 0.28 step. gates: error_rate > 1.7% OR p95 latency increase > 20% OR token_cost > +8% OR fallback-rate > 2% -> pause and page #eng-oncall. soft session-drain 9m for canary. Good to proceed from my side. :thumbsup:

deploybot: automated: created canary pool Delta (7 hosts). llm_fastpath_toggle -> 0.04. telemetry stream /ops/telemetry/deploy/7975312468 live. holdpoint scheduled at step 3.

oncall: copied gates and contact list into thread. if page, escalate to oncall->senior-runner.

zoe: enabling lightweight smoke and regression checks: smoke_quick + regset_edge_v1. Quality gate: f1_delta <= 0.9% and pass on long-context prompts. watching cache-hit ratio and fallback patterns.

matt: adding rollback snippet so support has it handy:
```
# immediate flag revert + canary drain
curl -X PATCH -H 'Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN' https://api.redwood/flags/llm_fastpath_toggle -d '{"value":0}'
# drain canary pool quickly
deploybot action: drain --pool canaryDelta --grace 540
# pin routing for enterprise back to model v2.0
curl -X POST -H 'Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN' https://api.redwood/routing/pin -d '{"cohort":"enterprise","model":"v2.0"}'
```

deploybot: canary Delta metrics @ +7m: error_rate=0.8% p95=215ms (+12%) token_cost=+5% fallback_rate=0.9% regset_edge_v1 delta=+0.2% -> within gates. proceeding to 0.28 in 10m. snapshot saved: /ops/telemetry/deploy/7975312468/snap-1

infra-bot: autoscale headroom scheduled: +25% GPU capacity at +10m.

zoe: note - support playbook updated with pinned-version blurb and rollback steps. will post short release note to #release-notes after final green. pinging #support and #security for awareness.

matt: if any gate trips I'll trigger fast-drain and pin enterprise routing back immediately. otherwise plan to let deploybot promote to 1.0 at 00:10 UTC. :eyes:

deploybot: holdpoint check at step 3: gates clear. scheduling next tilt to 0.7 in 12m. final promote scheduled at 00:10 UTC unless holdpoint trips.

oncall: monitoring groups standing by. will update here on any page.

zoe: last note - if p50 latency regresses > 12% we pause and triage; if quality delta > 1.0% we abort and run rollback snippet above. updates every 8-12m or immediately on gate trip.
